verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_tax_codes' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_tax_codes__code' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_purchase_invoices' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_purchase_returns' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_purchase_invoices__branch_document' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_purchase_returns__branch_document' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_purchase_invoices__warehouse_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_purchase_returns__warehouse_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_purchase_invoice_lines__tax_code' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_sales_quote_lines__tax_code' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_sales_order_lines__tax_code' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_sales_invoice_lines__tax_code' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_sales_return_lines__tax_code' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_purchase_invoices__due_requires_counterparty' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'ct_purchase_invoice_lines__product_unit_match_at_commit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'ct_purchase_return_lines__source_match_at_commit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the migration back. After successful production apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve Purchasing documents/history and issue a corrective migration rather than dropping integrity constraints or rewriting committed migration history. Purchase Returnable Quantity enforcement remains a transaction-service rule using FOR UPDATE on the original PurchaseInvoiceLine plus same-transaction recomputation. Independent Purchasing/Tax query/performance indexes remain deferred to Phase 03.07.
